execution.browser: Source-verified wallet/NFT execution with explicit review and receipt recovery; local economic models have separate rehearsal routes.
execution.solidity: Compiler and contract sizes are recorded in reports/contract-sizes.json; no public deployment is implied.
execution.evmTested: See docs/CAPABILITIES-6.1.md and the release validation records. Local EVM execution does not establish public Ethereum deployment.

separation: independently encrypted mint EOA per project

activation.isolationScope: cell route; generic Bound owner execution and independent direct module calls remain possible
activation.mainnetEnablementMeaning: No deployed public release is attested by this source manifest.

modules.label: Token launches, community sales and streaming auctions
dependencies: funded wallet or verified NFT account for compatible v4 operations
private services and shielded funds when selected
modules.authority: The signing wallet approves each call. Compatible v4 launches, swaps and redemptions can use the verified NFT account; community and auction participant actions use the signing wallet.
modules.privacy: Public launch outputs and economics. Optional shielded funding for supported v4 launches, including configured creator hooks; community contributions and auction bids remain public.
modules.exit: v4 LP redemption; community withdrawal before close and failure refunds; auction cancellation of unfilled bids and pull claims
modules.economics: Separate mechanisms: immediate v4 liquidity, proportional community settlement in NativeMarket, and ANIMA streaming lots. Not interchangeable and not official Uniswap CCA.
modules.explanation: Create and fund a token market, run a community raise, or release auction lots. Participants can open an exact launch link, read terms, contribute and claim through their wallets.
modules.limitations: Local contract transactions and interface tests are evidence of implementation, not public deployment. Immediate v4 retained tokens are not automatically vested; LP shares remain redeemable. Official CCA/Doppler strategies and automatic auction-to-DEX migration are not integrated.
modules.entrance: Launch → Create / My launches / Community / Auctions / Fee streams / Private wallet / Setup

modules.label: v4 swap with explicit funding privacy
dependencies: signing wallet or funded private wallet
modules.authority: Reviewed exact input, minimum output, deadline and selected funding account. No silent public fallback.
modules.privacy: User selects public or shielded execution; the underlying pool and trading activity remain public.
modules.economics: Primary Swap opens the actual v4 desk. The advanced NativeMarket journal route is a distinct mechanism.
modules.explanation: Choose tokens, an amount and your privacy route, then inspect the real transaction before signing or proving it.
modules.limitations: Private execution requires synchronized shielded funds and configured services. Automatic output locking is not included in every v4 swap route.

modules.label: Consent-based future gift
modules.authority: donor funds; recipient accepts; fixed beneficiary
modules.exit: donor recall until acceptance; permissionless expiry return; no early exit after acceptance
modules.explanation: Put aside a gift for someone. They choose whether to accept it, and you choose when it becomes available.

modules.label: Declared-content artifact sale
modules.authority: escrow and two inventory checks
modules.exit: cancel listing; no reversal of completed purchase
modules.limitations: Bounded declared module universe, not discovery of all external liabilities. Local exact hashes differ from contract predicates.
modules.explanation: Sell the main NFT together with the belongings and promises that its configured inventory knows about.

modules.label: Commons: encrypted conversations and public rooms
dependencies: PrivacyKeys and EpochGroupChat for encrypted conversations
WorldLedger and NFT account for public rooms
modules.authority: Encrypted chat identity is the signing wallet and its encryption key. Public-room writes use verified NFT account authority.
modules.privacy: Encrypted group contents; group metadata remains public. The separate public-room route publishes readable text.
modules.explanation: Open private conversations directly, discover invitations and groups, or deliberately enter clearly marked public rooms.
modules.limitations: Only the encrypted conversation route protects message contents. PrivacyKeys/EpochGroupChat and registered encryption identities must be configured; no memory-handover contract is required just for chat.
modules.entrance: Commons → Conversations / Encryption keys / Setup; Public rooms ↗

modules.label: Continuous clearing auction
modules.explanation: Keep a standing bid while new sale inventory is released. Claim purchased tokens and recover unused bids.
modules.authority: Exact contract permissions and explicit wallet reviews; NFT custody invalidates applicable account sessions.
modules.limitations: Independent ANIMA uniform-price streaming mechanism with 64 standing orders. No Uniswap CCA compliance or automatic liquidity migration.

modules.label: Encrypted memory handover
modules.explanation: Encrypt an agent memory for its recipient. They decrypt and verify it before accepting the NFT in one transaction.
dependencies: exact NFT approval and recipient signature
modules.authority: The current NFT owner proposes; the addressed recipient decrypts, verifies and explicitly accepts. Sale alone never transfers the private key.
modules.limitations: Recipient-confirmed content verification, not ERC-7857 or zero-knowledge handover. Old content may remain with the seller.
modules.entrance: Atlas → Advanced → Specialist instruments → Private communication

modules.label: Continuous scoped agent
modules.explanation: Let a running operator repeat an exact owner-approved action with a spending limit, waiting time and expiry.
modules.authority: Exact contract permissions and explicit wallet reviews; NFT custody invalidates applicable account sessions.
modules.limitations: Bound-account scoped operator. Arbitrary autonomous decision-making and Sovereign-mode proof generation are not supplied.

modules.label: Authenticated cross-chain witnesses
modules.explanation: Carry an NFT state observation through a sealed authenticated route without granting remote spending power.
modules.authority: Exact contract permissions and explicit wallet reviews; NFT custody invalidates applicable account sessions.
modules.limitations: Requires real LayerZero endpoints, explicit DVNs/libraries/executor configuration and peer deployments. Tests use local endpoint doubles.

modules.label: Encrypted group chat
modules.explanation: Discover your groups and invitations, accept membership, restore encrypted history, rotate group keys, and encrypt each message before wallet review.
dependencies: verified PrivacyKeys and EpochGroupChat, or wallet-signed deployment
matching encryption key or encrypted backup
modules.authority: Wallet-signed recipient consent and manager-controlled membership/rotation. NFT sale never transfers chat keys or history.
modules.limitations: Up to 32 members. Custom P-256/HKDF/AES-GCM epoch protocol, not MLS or forward secrecy. Members retain previously decrypted contents; long-term recipient-key compromise can expose historical packages. Membership, sender, timing and approximate size remain public.
modules.privacy: Plaintext and private keys stay in the private browser surface; only encrypted packages and padded ciphertext reach contracts.

modules.label: Funded public-goods matching
modules.explanation: Add a funded matching pot to capped contributions and pay each project its calculated share.
modules.authority: Exact contract permissions and explicit wallet reviews; NFT custody invalidates applicable account sessions.
modules.limitations: A disclosed immutable registrar attests unique people; this does not cryptographically eliminate Sybil identities or collusion.

modules.label: Sponsored account actions
modules.explanation: Have a relayer pay transaction gas using an exact owner-and-sponsor signed request and the sponsor’s funded budget.
modules.authority: Exact contract permissions and explicit wallet reviews; NFT custody invalidates applicable account sessions.
modules.limitations: Native account-session relay, not an ERC-4337 paymaster. Capped reimbursement with fixed overhead may not cover the relayer’s whole cost.

modules.label: Publish, adopt and grant an instrument
modules.authority: Public code is not permission. Seven-day adoption; exact caller, calldata, target, per-call/lifetime ceiling and expiry.
modules.exit: Immediate revocation; custody change invalidates grant.
modules.limitations: Local recipes include the existing action vocabulary. Dedicated onchain router implements swap/direct lock; no arbitrary bytecode or AI executor.
modules.explanation: Publish an instrument recipe, adopt an edition, and separately give an exact, limited permission to use funds.

modules.label: Prefunded work and acceptance
modules.authority: Worker accepts a fixed personal reviewer and deadline/refund policy. Selling the NFT does not change either person.
modules.exit: Payment on acceptance or refund after rejection/timeout.
modules.limitations: Human judgment is not verified task correctness. No appeals or automatic compensation. Source stores a deliverable digest; local model additionally binds its edition author.
modules.explanation: Set aside a fixed payment for a job, choose the worker and reviewer, and pay or refund after the decision or deadline.

modules.label: Artifact-owned bonded sell shelves
modules.authority: Item and proceeds held separately; market operating rights follow the artifact.
modules.exit: After fixed bond, return unsold item or withdraw proceeds.
modules.limitations: One fixed-price sell shelf; not a buy wall, two-sided AMM or a whole-artifact exchange. Rehearsal collectibles are fictional.
modules.explanation: Put one item on a fixed-price shelf. Later collect the sale money or take back the unsold item after its waiting period.

modules.label: Commitment-aware artifact exchange
modules.authority: Listing commits to known gifts, grants, work, cells, venues and schedules.
modules.exit: Seller refreshes a changed manifest; old buyer review cannot execute.
modules.limitations: New deployments and explicit configuration required. Old immutable accounts and exchanges are unchanged.
modules.explanation: Inspect the promises attached to an NFT before selling it. The sale checks the configured promises again.

modules.label: Strategy-share conversion
modules.authority: Only explicitly funded cell assets; recipient pinned to that cell.
modules.exit: Redeem subject to the underlying strategy; no promise of liquidity.
modules.limitations: Local model is not a live strategy and promises no yield. External vault solvency remains separate.
modules.explanation: An experimental adapter exchanges assets for shares in a chosen vault. It cannot promise profits or instant withdrawal.

modules.label: Fixed basket issuance
modules.authority: Round deposits up and redemptions down; measure exact receipts.
modules.limitations: Not the original underfunded Issue implementation. Simplified two-asset basket; source dust has a fixed beneficiary.
modules.explanation: An experimental two-asset basket lets people deposit the required ingredients and redeem shares for backing.

modules.label: Matched principal / income study
modules.authority: Proportional recombination of matched pairs including losses.
modules.exit: Return proportional remaining backing; no nominal-principal priority.
modules.limitations: Not separately tradable principal/yield tokens or a live yield market.
modules.explanation: An experimental accounting study separates matched claims and recombines them against the remaining backing.

modules.label: Negotiated collateralized credit
modules.authority: Named parties, collateral and exact repayment; no oracle or root-NFT pawn authority.
modules.exit: Repay before due; collateral to lender at/after default deadline.
modules.limitations: Not flash liquidity, dynamic liquidation, unrestricted lending or a safety endorsement.
modules.explanation: An experimental loan agreement records the lender, borrower, collateral, repayment amount, and due date.

modules.label: Physically covered calls
modules.authority: Full cover at creation; only named holder exercises before expiry.
modules.exit: Writer cancellation before sale; unsatisfied expiry returns cover.
modules.limitations: No naked options, oracle pricing or promised fair premium.
modules.explanation: An experimental covered option reserves the asset first, then gives a named holder the choice to buy before expiry.

modules.label: Application-edition commitments
modules.authority: Records identify a version; no uploaded program is evaluated.
modules.limitations: The local Applications panel stores commitments. Full immutable application storage is the separate onchain-runtime capability. No public-chain deployment is claimed.
modules.explanation: The local Applications panel records a version fingerprint. The separate immutable runtime archive stores the actual application bytes.

modules.label: House leveraged spot positions
modules.explanation: Borrow into an isolated real spot position, repay or sell it, and divide losses by an explicit order.
modules.authority: Exact contract permissions and explicit wallet reviews; NFT custody invalidates applicable account sessions.
modules.limitations: Test-network gate; lender-funded isolated spot leverage, not the original pooled synthetic book. Oracle, venue and liquidity are external.

modules.label: Wager outcome markets
modules.explanation: Fund and trade binary outcomes, challenge an answer and reclaim funds if the named authority misses its deadline.
modules.authority: Exact contract permissions and explicit wallet reviews; NFT custody invalidates applicable account sessions.
modules.limitations: Test-network gate. Question, source, resolver, arbiter and all cutoffs are fixed per market; those authorities can be wrong.

modules.label: Wake keeper windows
modules.explanation: Prepay a keeper seat, compensate a replaced keeper and allow public help when the holder stalls.
modules.authority: Exact contract permissions and explicit wallet reviews; NFT custody invalidates applicable account sessions.
modules.limitations: Test-network gate. Exclusivity covers the adapter route; underlying permissionless exits remain callable.

modules.label: Decision journal and general memories
modules.authority: Writing does not authorize a trade. Reflections belong to the original author; NFT sale does not transfer a decryption key.
modules.privacy: Explicit public body or client-encrypted AES-GCM body. Headers and timing are not confidential.
modules.exit: Export a complete archive; keep the passphrase separately. No recovery from the discarded original Seal Memory.
modules.limitations: Local encrypted journal and configurable public onchain memory desk. Keys do not transfer with the NFT. No funded public deployment is claimed.
modules.explanation: Keep a decision or memory, add later reflections, or deliberately publish a public memory to the NFT ledger.

modules.label: Activity-shaped optical form
modules.authority: A view projection, not account authority, rarity, reputation or financial value.
modules.privacy: No interpretation or display of private words. Optional memory imprint can be omitted; action metadata remain visible.
modules.exit: Compare original or inspect an earlier activity layer without undoing actions.
modules.limitations: History uses the current base genome. Finite visual parameters are not collision-resistant identity. Full protocol-wide onchain event admission, reorg handling and metadata linkage are not implemented.
modules.explanation: Local activity adds a bounded visual layer to the blue object. This decoration grants no extra spending rights.

modules.label: Atomic onchain journaled swap
modules.authority: Exact nonce, input, minimum output, deadline, temporary allowance and caller-account recipient.
modules.privacy: Contract stores full public bytes or supplied ciphertext; it receives no decryption key and cannot certify encryption.
modules.limitations: Typed NativeMarket wallet path and local EVM tests exist. The live desk publishes a consented public note; its optional local output-lock model is not an atomic journaled-swap-and-lock route.
modules.explanation: Make the trade and write its note in one transaction, so the note cannot claim a trade that failed.

modules.label: Vesting exits + decision receipts
modules.authority: fixed input, per-slice minimum, expiry and NFT recipient; owner epoch bound
modules.exit: cancel sales; recover only matured cancelled/expired slices
modules.limitations: local clock does not execute; live deployment and keeper not configured
modules.explanation: Fund a schedule that sells only eligible matured slices, with your minimum prices and deadline. A running keeper must trigger automatic sales.

modules.label: Mint sanctuary
modules.authority: independent EOA, exact reviews, narrow calldata grammar and application budget
modules.limitations: cannot observe other browser tabs; exported keys or compromised browser can bypass app caps
modules.explanation: Use a separate small wallet for a project mint, with encrypted backup and a review of each supported action.

modules.label: Original NFT identity and evolution
modules.explanation: Mint an identity, evolve it, commit a memory, add entropy, create a descendant, or review an irreversible authority change. The original local preview also rehearses these actions.
modules.authority: Ownership and proof rules are enforced by the deployed contracts.
modules.limitations: A visually similar projection is possible. The identity digest is authoritative; shared seeds and downloaded app code are public.

modules.label: NFT-controlled account and permissions
modules.explanation: Your NFT can hold assets and execute reviewed calls. Choose NFT funding for compatible v4 launches, swaps and liquidity redemption so their assets belong to the NFT account.
modules.authority: The current owner signs custody-bound calls; scoped grants and exact temporary allowances do not give arbitrary token access.
modules.limitations: Compatible operations require the verified account edition and current custody epoch. Private wallets, burner wallets and chat encryption identities remain separate. Same-collection master-NFT nesting is forbidden.
modules.entrance: Launch → Funding account; Atlas → Advanced → Developer console

modules.label: Cliff and linear token locks
modules.explanation: Put coins in a time box. Open it at one chosen time, or let the available amount grow gradually.
modules.authority: The lock beneficiary and vesting math control releases.
modules.exit: Release the matured amount; the interface cannot make an immature amount available.

modules.label: Blue-object interior and controls
modules.explanation: Move the camera into and out of the original optical object while retaining the same artwork identity and original turning controls.
modules.limitations: The original flat glow has an explicit depth continuation. No alternate object is substituted at the surface. Physical phone/browser/wallet interaction verification remains separate from source and renderer tests.
modules.entrance: Pinch/spread, wheel or Interior; return through the same scene

modules.label: v4 swaps, launch and liquidity redemption
modules.explanation: Create a fixed-supply token and a pool, trade through it, and redeem liquidity shares for their available assets.
modules.authority: Public wallet or supported NFT-account execution with review; shielded execution uses its separate private wallet.
modules.privacy: Public pools, tokens, amounts, fees and timings. Configured private routes shield supported funding/output linkage without guaranteeing anonymity.
modules.limitations: Actual local PoolManager execution exists, including creator-hook integration. Public deployment and funded proof/broadcaster end-to-end verification remain outstanding.
modules.entrance: Swap; Launch → My launches / Private wallet

modules.label: Encrypted private wallet and recovery
modules.explanation: Unlock a separate private wallet, preserve an encrypted backup, inspect shielded funds and prepare supported private operations.
modules.privacy: Recovery keys and plaintext notes stay offchain. Screen concealment is a separate display control, not transaction privacy.
modules.limitations: Locking does not cancel a transaction already broadcast or erase data retained by another application.
modules.entrance: Launch → Private wallet; Atlas → Private wallet

modules.label: Shielded execution integration
modules.explanation: Use shielded inputs and return supported token, LP-share and refund outputs to the shielded wallet, including a configured creator-hook launch route.
modules.privacy: The token, pool, supply, amounts, prices, timing and public hook/recipient configuration remain visible. Funding and recipient linkage can still be inferred from external observations.
modules.limitations: Local adapter/hook tests do not prove a funded RAILGUN proof or broadcaster submission. Circuit access, synchronization, POI/RPC services, compatible deployments and funded private balances remain necessary.
modules.entrance: Swap → Private; Launch → Create → Private funding

modules.label: Owner-chosen fee distribution
modules.explanation: Choose creator-fee recipients and weights, inspect fees accrued in their actual input assets, flush earned fees and claim recorded shares.
dependencies: verified creator hook and hooked launch factory
wallet review and actual accrued fee balances
modules.authority: The hook owner controls future fees and recipients. Existing deposited splitter entitlements remain with their recorded beneficiaries.
modules.limitations: No mandatory project recipient. Weights apply when fees enter the splitter. Automatic payout-asset conversion and reinvestment adapters are not supplied; earned fees are claimed in their actual currencies.
modules.entrance: Launch → Fee streams; Launch → Create → Creator fees

modules.label: Pinned-block transaction rehearsal
modules.explanation: Try a supported public action on a disposable copy of the blockchain and inspect what changed before signing.
modules.privacy: Private shielded payloads never enter this public-intent service.
modules.limitations: A measured local simulation is not a cryptographic proof or a guarantee about a later block.

modules.label: Commissioned calendar instruments
modules.explanation: Ask a chosen provider to make a release calendar, check its exact output, and acquire it as a frozen cartridge NFT held by your main NFT.
modules.authority: Acquiring an instrument grants no spending permission.
modules.limitations: This original recipe remains deterministic. New instruments separately supports arbitrary source review, provider discovery and paid-service adapters.

modules.label: Owned executable cartridges
modules.explanation: Hold a supported game or instrument NFT, verify its code, and open it in a separate play area.
modules.authority: Sandboxed opaque-origin frame; no wallet bridge by default. Browser isolation does not certify arbitrary programs safe.
modules.limitations: Compatible HTML cartridges and bundled local games are supported. Owning an arbitrary NFT does not make its game executable.

modules.label: Immutable application and wallet thumbnail
modules.explanation: The NFT carries a recoverable copy of its application and a seed-shaped wallet picture in immutable contract storage.
modules.authority: Everyone can read public application bytes; the owner controls protected transactions.
modules.limitations: Browser rendering and chain reads are still required. Updating a website does not replace bytes in an older immutable mint.

modules.label: Sealed modules and privacy worker shards
modules.explanation: A sealed directory tells the NFT where its tools are. Its large privacy worker is stored in checked fragments and rebuilt when needed.
modules.limitations: Worker bytes are archived; proving circuits, RPC, synchronization, proof services and broadcasters remain external.

modules.label: Paid services and job escrow
modules.explanation: Review and pay for a supported x402 service, or fund a separately reviewed provider job and its delivery rules.
modules.authority: Exact contract permissions and explicit wallet reviews; NFT custody invalidates applicable account sessions.
modules.limitations: x402 v2 exact EVM EIP-3009 through official SDK; separate ERC-8183 draft non-hooked kernel. Requires supported token and configured service.

modules.label: Open provider discovery
modules.explanation: Browse signed provider entries and compare attributable feedback from funded jobs.
modules.authority: Exact contract permissions and explicit wallet reviews; NFT custody invalidates applicable account sessions.
modules.limitations: ANIMA-native directory, not an ERC-8004 implementation. Signatures authenticate wallets, not quality, personhood or claims.

modules.label: Commission arbitrary programs
modules.explanation: Commission a new HTML and JavaScript tool, inspect its exact source, approve it and acquire a frozen cartridge.
modules.authority: Exact contract permissions and explicit wallet reviews; NFT custody invalidates applicable account sessions.
modules.limitations: Human approval and browser isolation do not prove arbitrary code safe. No default wallet bridge; exact proposals need separate review.

modules.label: Cryptographically proved quote
modules.explanation: Prove the exact integer math of a supported swap and bind it to the current NFT and market state before signing.
modules.authority: Exact contract permissions and explicit wallet reviews; NFT custody invalidates applicable account sessions.
modules.limitations: Groth16 development setup; one-hop NativeMarket arithmetic only. Full EVM execution, gas, token behavior and future state are not proved.

modules.label: Persistent shared world
modules.explanation: Meet other players, gather, craft, fight, found towns and trade in a persistent hosted world.
modules.authority: Exact contract permissions and explicit wallet reviews; NFT custody invalidates applicable account sessions.
modules.limitations: Working multiplayer civilization slice, not a complete mature MMO. Operator-authoritative game state and game coins have no onchain withdrawal.

modules.label: ENS named mint entry
modules.explanation: Mint an NFT and its deterministic subname together, then resolve that name back to the NFT’s real account.
modules.authority: Exact contract permissions and explicit wallet reviews; NFT custody invalidates applicable account sessions.
modules.limitations: Requires an explicitly delegated ENS parent. Does not purchase or renew a .eth domain; ancestor control and expiry remain applicable.

modules.label: Whole-NFT custody shares
modules.explanation: Wrap an unused NFT, share its economic custody, vote on a funded buyout or reunite every share to recover it.
modules.authority: Exact contract permissions and explicit wallet reviews; NFT custody invalidates applicable account sessions.
modules.limitations: Only unused Bound NFTs qualify. Account execution freezes while fractionalized; shares do not transfer private keys or every possible external right.

modules.label: Arbitrary EVM effect proofs
modules.explanation: Prove every relevant effect of an arbitrary contract transaction instead of trusting an execution service.
modules.limitations: Research remains. The delivered quote circuit proves only bounded NativeMarket arithmetic and current-state binding.

modules.label: General autonomous agent decisions
modules.explanation: Have an agent independently choose new multi-step actions while proving they follow the owner’s intent.
modules.limitations: Research remains. The delivered operator runs exact owner-approved calls with onchain limits; it does not supply unrestricted adaptive reasoning or Sovereign-mode proofs.

modules.label: Complete mature MMO civilization
modules.explanation: Build a production-scale multiplayer civilization with a complete content, progression and economic system.
modules.limitations: Broader project remains. This release supplies a persistent playable multiplayer slice, not a finished MMORPG.

modules.label: Public rooms and membership-controlled posting
modules.explanation: Read public chain messages, create a room, invite and accept members, post with consent, or moderate your room through NFT account reviews.
modules.authority: Room administrator/moderator powers and accepted posting membership; current NFT custody governs applicable account permissions.
modules.privacy: Public readable text, even when posting requires an invitation.
modules.limitations: Leaving or hiding content in the interface does not erase its chain history. Use encrypted conversations for confidential message contents.

modules.label: Shareable participant launch pages
modules.explanation: Open a link to an exact community sale or auction, read its verified terms, then connect your wallet to contribute, bid, withdraw or claim.
dependencies: explicit read RPC or connected wallet provider
modules.authority: Participant transactions use the signing wallet; they do not inherit the creator desk’s NFT funding choice.
modules.privacy: Public sale and auction state. No wallet is requested for explicit read-only RPC access; the chosen provider can observe those requests.
modules.limitations: Links cover community sales and ANIMA streaming auctions. They do not certify the creator, promise returns or automatically migrate auction liquidity.
modules.entrance: Launch → Community / Auctions → Copy participant link

modules.label: Screen concealment and local key lock
modules.explanation: Hide nearby-visible amounts or cover the screen, and separately lock private keys and erase displayed private fields.
modules.privacy: Display concealment does not encrypt transactions or messages. Encryption operations have their own independent controls.
modules.limitations: Locking cannot cancel an already submitted transaction or erase messages another member retained.
